- Use WebSocket long connecti"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ons, with no public webhook server."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Cards show bounded tool summaries, never hidden model reasoning."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Requirements: Node.js 22+, `pnpm`, a working DeepSeek Harness model configuration, and either an ins"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"talled `dsh` CLI or an official Harness source checkout nearby."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Run this from the Project you want the bot to control:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The setup command:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p50s1","text":"## Security and files"},{"id":"p51s1","text":"- Owners pair through the official authorization identity or a hashed, ten-minute, one-use `/claim` "},{"id":"p51s2","text":"code.
- Users, chats, Project access, and card operators are checked before an Agent action.
- Secre"},{"id":"p51s3","text":"ts are redacted from cards, errors, tool summaries, and spill files.
- Inbound files use `0700` dire"},{"id":"p51s4","text":"ctories and `0600` files with sanitized random names.
- Outbound files must resolve to regular files"},{"id":"p51s5","text":" inside the Project's `workspaceRoot`; symlink escapes are rejected.
- Incoming events are deduplica"},{"id":"p51s6","text":"ted, stale events are rejected, and each chat is serialized.
- One approval button grants one operat"},{"id":"p51s7","text":"e events are rejected, and each chat is serialized.
- One approval button grants one operation only."},{"id":"p52s1","text":"See SECURITY.md for the full trust model."}],"truncated":true}
